## Submission

- Organization / account:
- Type: organization base (manual) / vehicle shader / skin shader
- Release key and GTA model:
- Screenshots / short in-game video:
- Texture names and UV details:
- Tested with MTA version:

For shader submissions: request.json links to this PR; assets are original or
redistributable; the key is new; existing releases remain unchanged. Custom FX
must be tested by staff before merge. No credentials, payment data or private
server files are included.
